tool.description: Convert between JSON and YAML in either direction. direction='auto' (default) detects the input (text starting with '{' or '[' is JSON -> YAML, otherwise YAML -> JSON); set 'json-to-yaml' or 'yaml-to-json' to force it. pretty=true indents JSON output (yaml-to-json only). Data is preserved round-trip.

input.description: The JSON or YAML text to convert.

direction.description: Conversion direction. 'auto' (default): input starting with '{' or '[' is treated as JSON (-> YAML), otherwise YAML (-> JSON).

pretty.description: Pretty-print (indent) JSON output. Only affects yaml-to-json. Default false.
